name: jmq-textmate
description: Syntax highlighting for jMouse query documents — views, functions and sources.

textMateRules._comment: The converter pipe is the one thing neither JQL nor JPQL has, and the one a reader most needs to see: without it an ordered comparison over a bag of text compares words, and "900" is greater than "1000". Bold, so that its ABSENCE is what stands out on a line that needed it.

`unknown` is an admission, not a type — it says nobody has promised what an attribute holds. It is marked invalid-ish so a source file shows at a glance which attributes are unpromised, because those are the ones whose comparisons will be refused.
A reserved word is greyed out BEFORE the parser refuses it. A word held for a later version of the language should not look like a name that happens not to work.
